sign_diagnostic.note: The best dev gain is negative; the data support a confounder proxy (the nurse reacts to symptoms), not the plan's positive UF effect. Negative gains are reported only and are never adopted.

claim_boundary: Retrospective HEMOBP evaluation only. The ODE correction's calibrated gain is 0; every positive gain worsens MAE and the actual-vs-hold gate fails. The delivered model is a calibrated pre-anchor forecast plus a clearly labelled mechanism illustration — not a validated counterfactual twin, treatment effect, safety layer, or autonomous prescription. Forecast-v2 is oracle-assisted and is not the fair G2 baseline.
deviations: Reported nadir is the 60-minute bridge endpoint B(60); the raw trajectory minimum is also saved. The plan's min-over-[15,60] identity is false when mu > SBP_anchor, because the nadir label excludes the anchor cuff.
The bridge baseline is pre-anchor-only (59 features). Forecast-v2's 72 features include the observed future-UF oracle.
gamma=0 is allowed; the plan's [0.25, 1.25] floor was tested and worsens dev MAE (see plan_floor_gamma_0.25), so it was not adopted.
beta_vol bound widened to 24 mmHg/L to include the repo's own fitted population value (19.6).
The FE-2SLS instrument stage is replaced by a within-patient covariate-informed prior plus James-Stein shrinkage; the counterfactual gain is calibrated out-of-fold.
